race.description: Daish Irrigation And Fodder Stake Pr1 Division1
race.comment: ROCK IT ROGER (4) was strongly fancied last time but ran below expectations when fifth (30.15), beaten 6 lengths. Has winning claims on his best figures. CANYA DIVERSION (1) is mixing form and out of the placings last time but was a Grade 4/5 winner three starts ago and moves to Box 1 this time where he has performed well. Expected to do much better this time. LAMIA NONNA MIM (2) was a little disappointing last start at Gawler when 8th (31.56) over 531m. Has won here at this journey. Has ability and is one of the better chances. STOMP ROCKER (5) scored by 7 lengths last time (30.84) in a Grade 6 over 530m at Angle Park. Has already won two times from this draw.
